column1: # derivation: §9.1, §9.7: a ROWS frame counts physical rows of the current
# partition only. cnt_ahead and cnt_v_ahead: COUNT(*) and COUNT(v) over
# ROWS 2 FOLLOWING .. 3 FOLLOWING; cnt_behind: COUNT(*) over ROWS 2
# PRECEDING .. 1 PRECEDING. An empty frame counts 0 (§8.27); COUNT(v) skips
# Types: id, g, v, w, u keep their scanned types; windowed COUNT is INT64,
